title: test(plugin-security): give each subject state its own it in the delegated-answer ground-truth posture pin
body:

_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9WRooEf1dKxwnV3qGKCubny)_

Fixes #31919

The card's fix: the ground-truth case that booted one rig per subject state inside a single `it` is split into one `it` per state, the shape commit 7200f540 already gave the sibling block in the same file. Claim 6739551496 (`domain:server#1`, card-thread session_01ADHkmSzW7smpTAzJNeCnD2).

Clause-②: yes (test only, no contract change) — measured: the diff is one test file; no source file, request shape or answer changes, so nothing accepted on base is refused on head and nothing refused is accepted.
Metadata-protocol: none

`skip-changeset`: the diff is one test file under `src/` that the package does not ship (`plugin-security`'s `files[]` publishes `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`; after a full build the `dist/` tree holds 0 files with this case's title text, against a positive control, `DelegationScopeViolationError`, in 2 built files), so nothing any released package publishes changes.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：plugin-security 的一个权限测试里，"真值"用例原来在同一个用例里为 5 种用户状态各启动一套环境，现在每种状态是自己的用例；同文件里另外 3 个同样"循环里每轮启动一套环境"的对照用例也按同样方式拆开。
- 为什么改：这个用例在合并队列负载高时超过默认 5 秒超时，把同批不相关的 PR（#31864）一起踢出队列；拆开后每种状态有自己的 5 秒预算和自己的失败行。
- 风险与回滚：只改一个测试文件，产品代码零改动；断言一条没删没改，用例数 202 → 226。回滚就是 revert 这一个提交。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/delegated-admin-own-name-set.posture.test.ts` 的 ground truth 那段（约 869 行），再看 913、1130、1256 行附近的三处对照拆分。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run src/delegated-admin-own-name-set.posture.test.ts`，预期 226 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

One test file, four splits, each the same mechanical shape (a loop that boots a rig per iteration inside one `it` becomes a `describe` keeping the old title, with one `it.each` case per iteration):

| Case (per posture: single, group, isolated) | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| ground truth: the delegate reads the subject exactly in the states where it is a user the delegate may read | 1 `it`, 5 boots | 5 `it` (`[...STATES, CONTROL]`), 1 boot each |
| CONTROL: a tenant-level administrator and the organization administrator still remove the stored grant … | 1 `it`, 2 boots | 2 `it`, 1 boot each |
| CONTROL: a tenant-level administrator still moves the grant FROM / TO a holder outside the scope … (one case per end) | 1 `it` per end, 2 boots | 2 `it` per end, 1 boot each |
| CONTROL: a tenant-level administrator re-names a grant freely … | 1 `it`, 2 boots | 2 `it`, 1 boot each |

Case count: 202 → 226 (+12 ground truth, +3 removal, +6 moves, +3 re-naming).

**Assertion targets, before and after: the same set.** Each `expect` keeps its subject, matcher, expected value and message label byte-identical; only its enclosing `it` changes.

- ground truth: `expect(reads, state).toBe(state !== 'an id naming no user' && state !== UNREADABLE_INSIDE)`, once per state, 5 states × 3 postures = 15, before and after.
- removal: `expect(removed, who).toEqual({ status: 200 })` and `expect(left, who).toEqual([])`, per remover, 2 × 2 × 3 = 12, before and after.
- moves: `expect(throughWriteDoor(…), state).toEqual({ status: 200 })` and `expect(holderOf(…), state).toBe(ENDS[end].user_id)`, per state per end, 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 = 24, before and after.
- re-naming: `expect(renameThroughWriteDoor(…), label).toEqual({ status: 200 })` and `expect(setOf(…), label).toBe(to)`, per re-naming, 2 × 2 × 3 = 12, before and after.

⛔ No timeout raised: the slowest split case measured 360 ms locally, far from the 5 s budget. No forced test edit elsewhere.

**Scan of the other plugin-security posture files** (`by-id-write-row-reread`, `delegable-scope-no-identity-positions`, `org-admin-assignment-boundary`): every `it` there boots one rig and loops only over calls against it, so none has the shape; nothing changed there. In this file, the other loops inside an `it` (delegable-scope report, explain per unit, writes per unit) also run against one rig.

## Tests

Local runs on head 2a121acf (the commit this body describes), 3 workers as CI's `VITEST_MAX_WORKERS`, `--sequence.concurrent=false`, JSON reporter, under the verify lock:

- this file alone 5× on base 6a8f4151: 5/5 green, 202 cases each. Old single cases, max of 5 runs: ground truth 797 / 706 / 558 ms (group / isolated / single); moves-FROM 767 ms (group); re-naming 528 ms (single); removal 340 ms (group).
- this file alone 5× on head: 5/5 green, 226 cases each, 0 failures. The slowest of the 24 split cases: 360 ms (moves FROM, single, unreadable-inside); ground-truth states 104–237 ms.
- the CI timeout itself does not reproduce locally (old case max 0.8 s against 5 s); the cause is shard load in the merge group, which the split answers by giving each boot its own budget.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: Test Files 252 passed (252), Tests 6092 passed | 45 skipped (6137).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security typecheck`: exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck` OK, 0 errors).
- `eslint packages/plugins/plugin-security --no-inline-config` (the package's `lint` script spelling, from the root): exit 0.

No ablation: no tested behaviour changes, and no negative pin is added or moved.

## Acceptance notes

- Each split case still boots its own rig, as the old loop did per iteration; the work per posture is the same, only the budget is per case.
- The removal and re-naming `it.each` tables carry contexts built with `delegateCtx` at collection time; the old loop built the same objects inside the `it`. `delegateCtx` is a pure object literal.
